patients.presenting_details: Found pulseless and apnoeic at ED entrance; CPR initiated immediately.
patients.history_summary: No prior record available; identity initially unconfirmed.
patients.data_quality_notes: Pulse, respiration, oxygen saturation, and blood pressure not measurable on arrival.
patients.expected_resources: Immediate resuscitation; resource prediction not used at ESI decision point.
patients.reference_label_rationale: Requires immediate life-saving intervention (CPR/airway-resuscitation pathway).
patients.uncertainty_notes: Reference label is clear from the immediate resuscitation requirement; identity/history remain unknown.

patients.presenting_details: Known COPD; cyanotic, exhausted, shallow respirations and unable to complete sentences.
patients.history_summary: COPD; hypertension; prior non-invasive ventilation admission.
patients.data_quality_notes: All initial vitals available; oxygen saturation measured before supplemental oxygen.
patients.expected_resources: Immediate ventilatory/airway support; resource prediction not used at ESI decision point.
patients.reference_label_rationale: Severe respiratory failure with depressed consciousness requires immediate ventilatory support.
patients.uncertainty_notes: Exact intervention is clinician-determined; synthetic case intentionally represents an immediate airway/breathing threat.

patients.presenting_details: Rapid-onset urticaria, stridor and hypotension after eating; suspected anaphylaxis.
patients.history_summary: No prior hospital record available.
patients.data_quality_notes: History supplied by accompanying friend; allergen not confirmed.
patients.expected_resources: Immediate anaphylaxis/airway treatment; resource prediction not used at ESI decision point.
patients.reference_label_rationale: Airway compromise and shock require immediate life-saving treatment.
patients.uncertainty_notes: Trigger is uncertain, but immediate airway/circulatory threat is not.

patients.presenting_details: Burning discomfort after a meal with diaphoresis and left-arm heaviness; reflux versus acute coronary syndrome.
patients.history_summary: First visit; smoking and family-history fields not yet known.
patients.data_quality_notes: Incomplete cardiovascular history at initial intake.
patients.expected_resources: Time-sensitive clinician assessment; likely ECG/laboratory evaluation under local protocol.
patients.reference_label_rationale: Potential time-sensitive cardiac presentation is high risk despite relatively preserved initial vitals.
patients.uncertainty_notes: Deliberately ambiguous presentation; reference level prioritizes the dangerous plausible diagnosis rather than the benign one.

patients.chief_complaint: Sudden speech difficulty and right-arm weakness
patients.presenting_details: Facial droop, aphasia and unilateral weakness witnessed 45 minutes before arrival.
patients.history_summary: Hypertension; dyslipidaemia; no prior stroke recorded.
patients.data_quality_notes: History confirmed by family; last-known-well time available.
patients.expected_resources: Immediate stroke-pathway clinician assessment and time-sensitive diagnostics.
patients.reference_label_rationale: Acute focal neurological deficit is a high-risk, time-sensitive presentation.
patients.uncertainty_notes: Final diagnosis is not assumed; triage priority is based on time-sensitive risk.

patients.presenting_details: Six-week-old infant with reduced feeding and rectal temperature 38.4 C.
patients.history_summary: No hospital record; birth and immunisation history being confirmed.
patients.data_quality_notes: Self-reported pain is not developmentally appropriate; caregiver observations used.
patients.expected_resources: Urgent pediatric clinician assessment and age-specific fever pathway.
patients.reference_label_rationale: Very young febrile infant with reduced feeding is treated as a high-risk presentation.
patients.uncertainty_notes: Age-specific protocol and clinician assessment determine final urgency; pediatric review is essential.

patients.presenting_details: Family reports abrupt functional decline; possible infection with blunted fever response.
patients.history_summary: Type 2 diabetes; chronic kidney disease; baseline cognitively intact.
patients.data_quality_notes: Symptoms reported by family because patient is confused.
patients.expected_resources: Urgent clinician assessment for sepsis/metabolic/neurological causes.
patients.reference_label_rationale: Acute altered mental status with borderline hypotension is high risk, especially in a geriatric patient.
patients.uncertainty_notes: Cause is uncertain; label reflects deterioration risk rather than a presumed diagnosis.

patients.presenting_details: Reports intent and access to means; calm and cooperative at triage.
patients.history_summary: Prior depression diagnosis; previous self-harm documented.
patients.data_quality_notes: Physiological vitals are stable; risk is primarily behavioural/psychiatric.
patients.expected_resources: Immediate safety precautions and urgent licensed-clinician mental-health assessment.
patients.reference_label_rationale: Active suicidal intent is a high-risk safety presentation despite normal vital signs.
patients.uncertainty_notes: Synthetic scenario requires local behavioural-health safety protocol; AI must not independently clear the patient.

patients.presenting_details: Progressive focal abdominal pain with nausea; haemodynamically stable.
patients.history_summary: No prior record; pregnancy status and surgical history not yet known.
patients.data_quality_notes: Important history fields remain incomplete at initial intake.
patients.expected_resources: Laboratory testing; imaging; parenteral medication/fluids.
patients.reference_label_rationale: Stable presentation expected to require multiple ED resources, without an identified ESI-1/2 criterion in the synthetic snapshot.
patients.uncertainty_notes: Pregnancy and examination findings could increase urgency; clinician review may change the reference level.

patients.presenting_details: Two days of vomiting; dry mucosa but alert, interactive and perfusing.
patients.history_summary: No chronic disease; prior visits available; vaccinations current per caregiver.
patients.data_quality_notes: Weight is not included in this first dataset version and would be required for treatment decisions.
patients.expected_resources: Laboratory assessment and oral/IV rehydration decision under pediatric protocol.
patients.reference_label_rationale: Stable child likely to require two or more ED resources; age-adjusted clinician assessment remains necessary.
patients.uncertainty_notes: Degree of dehydration is examination-dependent and could alter urgency.

patients.presenting_details: Unable to bear weight; no head strike, syncope or anticoagulant use reported.
patients.history_summary: Osteoporosis; hypertension; not taking anticoagulants.
patients.data_quality_notes: History corroborated by medication list and caregiver.
patients.expected_resources: Imaging and analgesic treatment; possible orthopedic assessment.
patients.reference_label_rationale: Stable presentation expected to require multiple resources for suspected hip injury.
patients.uncertainty_notes: Occult head injury or instability would require escalation; neither is represented in this synthetic snapshot.

patients.presenting_details: Dysuria followed by fever, vomiting and unilateral flank pain; alert with preserved blood pressure.
patients.history_summary: First hospital visit; pregnancy, renal and medication history incomplete.
patients.data_quality_notes: Zero-history scenario with clinically relevant unknown fields.
patients.expected_resources: Urine/laboratory testing; medication/fluids; possible imaging.
patients.reference_label_rationale: Currently stable but expected to require multiple ED resources and close reassessment.
patients.uncertainty_notes: Potential infection may deteriorate; uncertainty is increased by missing pregnancy and comorbidity history.

patients.presenting_details: Colicky pain radiating to groin with nausea; stable and alert.
patients.history_summary: Prior renal stone; no single kidney documented.
patients.data_quality_notes: Prior episode available in hospital record.
patients.expected_resources: Urinalysis/laboratory testing; imaging; parenteral analgesia.
patients.reference_label_rationale: Stable patient expected to require multiple ED resources.
patients.uncertainty_notes: Fever, anuria or solitary kidney would change risk; those features are absent from this scenario.

patients.presenting_details: Known diabetes with home glucose reported as very high; no Kussmaul breathing or altered mental status.
patients.history_summary: Type 2 diabetes; oral medication; prior laboratory results available.
patients.data_quality_notes: Home glucose value is patient-reported and requires confirmation.
patients.expected_resources: Point-of-care/laboratory testing and medication/fluids depending on results.
patients.reference_label_rationale: Stable presentation expected to require multiple resources to exclude a metabolic emergency.
patients.uncertainty_notes: Confirmed glucose, ketones and acid-base status are unavailable at triage and could change urgency.

patients.presenting_details: Clean 3 cm superficial laceration; bleeding controlled, normal movement and sensation.
patients.history_summary: No prior record; tetanus status being confirmed by caregiver.
patients.data_quality_notes: Neurovascular findings are synthetic examination observations.
patients.expected_resources: Wound closure is the expected single ED resource.
patients.reference_label_rationale: Stable presentation expected to require one ED resource (wound closure).
patients.uncertainty_notes: Deeper injury, contamination or neurovascular deficit would alter the label; not present here.

patients.presenting_details: Dysuria and frequency without fever, flank pain, vomiting or pregnancy concern.
patients.history_summary: One uncomplicated UTI two years earlier; no renal disease.
patients.data_quality_notes: Pregnancy concern explicitly denied in the synthetic history but would be verified clinically.
patients.expected_resources: Urine testing is the expected single ED resource.
patients.reference_label_rationale: Stable presentation expected to require one ED resource.
patients.uncertainty_notes: Systemic symptoms or pregnancy could increase urgency; neither is represented.

patients.presenting_details: Lateral ankle swelling after sports injury; distal neurovascular status intact.
patients.history_summary: No prior hospital record available.
patients.data_quality_notes: Weight-bearing status documented; formal imaging decision remains clinician-owned.
patients.expected_resources: Plain radiograph is the expected single ED resource.
patients.reference_label_rationale: Stable isolated injury expected to require one ED resource.
patients.uncertainty_notes: Open injury, neurovascular deficit or high-energy mechanism would change urgency; absent here.

patients.presenting_details: Two days of sore throat and nasal congestion; drinking normally, no breathing difficulty.
patients.history_summary: No prior hospital record available.
patients.data_quality_notes: No red-flag symptoms represented; examination remains clinician-owned.
patients.expected_resources: No ED resource anticipated beyond examination and discharge advice.
patients.reference_label_rationale: Stable minor complaint with no anticipated ED resources.
patients.uncertainty_notes: Airway symptoms, dehydration or immunocompromise would alter urgency; absent or unknown here.

patients.presenting_details: Ran out of stable antihypertensive medication; asymptomatic with no acute complaint.
patients.history_summary: Hypertension; stable medication list and recent outpatient visit available.
patients.data_quality_notes: Medication reconciliation is available from prior record.
patients.expected_resources: No ED resource anticipated beyond examination/prescription workflow.
patients.reference_label_rationale: Asymptomatic request with no anticipated ED resources.
patients.uncertainty_notes: Symptoms or markedly abnormal confirmed blood pressure would require reassessment; absent here.

patients.presenting_details: Small itchy area on forearm; no facial swelling, wheeze, vomiting or systemic symptoms.
patients.history_summary: First visit; allergy history not available in hospital records.
patients.data_quality_notes: Explicit contrast case to PT-003; current systemic red flags are absent.
patients.expected_resources: No ED resource anticipated beyond examination and advice.
